elements.label: Prompt text being typed
elements.text: Any updates on the mobile improvements project?

pattern.description: A question is typed character by character into the Notion AI chat input with a blinking caret; the input grows from a single row to a two-row field with an 'In: All sources' scope line, while the large mascot face beside the panel shifts its expression as if reading along.
pattern.why_premium: Realistic burst-typing cadence sells a real product interaction, and the reactive mascot on the brand-blue side panel gives the AI a personality without leaving the UI demo.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.to('.prompt-text', {text: 'Any updates on the mobile improvements project?', duration: 0.9, ease: 'none'}) (TextPlugin, or step the characters via a counter in bursts of 2-4 chars per frame); at the first char gsap.to('.prompt-input', {height: '+=36', duration: 0.15, ease: 'power2.out'}); swap mascot face states with a short gsap.to on eyebrow/eye paths (morph) in parallel.
build_hint.remotion: const chars = Math.floor(interpolate(frame, [0, 26], [0, text.length], {extrapolateRight: 'clamp'})); render text.slice(0, chars) + caret; input height via interpolate(spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200}}), [0,1], [48, 84]); mascot face swaps SVG states or interpolates path points over ~12 frames.

notes: Energy alternates every other frame, consistent with typing on twos. Text from OCR (trailing caret removed). Mascot face change is subtle (eye/brow shift); exact nature ambiguous at filmstrip scale. The suggestions list (b04/b07/b10-b15/b18-b20) shows small changed shares, possibly a slight upward shift when the input grows; not listed as moving elements.
